author: Gert Marginet
name: CAT Dapper command
description: A command with a Dapper handler and its .sql file. The Infrastructure project needs the packages gmarginet.Cat.Dapper and gmarginet.Cat.Dapper.SqlFiles, and the line AdditionalFiles Include="**/*.sql" in its project file. Run it in the folder of the solution of a service.

ServiceName.description: The full name of the service, such as Contoso.Shop.Orders.
